script_phases.name: Generate Ansight Developer Build Artifacts
script_phases.script:
set -euo pipefail

TOOL="${DERIVED_FILE_DIR}/ansight-build-tool"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "${TOOL}")" "${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}/src/ios/Generated/CocoaPods"
MACOS_SDK="$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
SDKROOT="${MACOS_SDK}" xcrun --sdk macosx swiftc -sdk "${MACOS_SDK}" "${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}/src/ios/Plugins/AnsightBuildTool/"*.swift -o "${TOOL}"
"${TOOL}"   --output-file "${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}/src/ios/Generated/CocoaPods/AnsightGeneratedBuildArtifacts.swift"   --target-directory "${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}/src/ios/Sources/AnsightCore"   --package-directory "${PODS_TARGET_SRCROOT}/src/ios"
